meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 12-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (orchestrator manual QA plus one gate reviewer) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

howto.what: 发布 npm 包前,Claude 会先查出自上次发布以来的所有改动,分派最多 10 个 ultrabrain agent 逐个改动组深查,再跑 /review-work 整体评审,最后由 1 个 oracle 汇总版本号建议与发布风险。
howto.when: 当你明确说 “pre-publish review”、“ready to publish?” 等发布前审查请求时触发;普通的发布请求不会触发,/publish 直接发布。

howto.what_en: Before publishing to npm, Claude runs a 12-agent release gate: it detects changes since the last release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents per change group, runs /review-work, and uses 1 oracle to summarize version bump and release risk.
howto.when_en: Triggered only when you explicitly ask for a pre-publish review, e.g. "pre-publish review" or "ready to publish?". A plain publish request does not trigger it; /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Review the changes before I publish
say_en.note: Spawns ultrabrain agents per change group

say_en.text: Can I publish this version? Give me the version bump.
say_en.note: Oracle summarizes risk and version bump
